pending.title: XSS vs CSRF: Attacks & Defenses
outline: Part 1: Diagramming XSS (executing malicious JS to exfiltrate data) vs CSRF (riding ambient cookies to forge state-changing requests), ending with: how do browsers now block CSRF without custom backend code?
Part 2: Visualizing SameSite cookie attributes (Strict, Lax, None) alongside Anti-CSRF sync-tokens to eliminate unauthorized cross-site writes.
